value.rationale: The 2021 paper supplies 3^(n-1)-1 coherent path vertices without a Euclidean metric extremal classification. This natural quantitative geometry question admits a sharp all-dimensional answer: a continuously orientation-dependent circumball controlled solely by the largest two heights and only two of exponentially many vertices, with a nontrivial strict multistep clearance. The result is not a parameter substitution or transfer of a canonical polar radius: it relies on optimizing a new convex quadratic over the ordered-height simplex.
